lines.text: Good grief, I don't think I've even laid eyes upon such a weak Commander.
I'll never obey any command that comes from an impostor's mouth.
Ah~ I said I would protect you from now on!

Your weakness is simply one of your many charms.
This way, the only way I'll lose is if I let you win on purpose! Hehehe.

Imposter, very well, you may caress my hair.
Not everyone can earn this privilege.
Hypocrite, whenever you stare off into space like that, your weakness is...too much to take. Blech...
Hey, why didn't you choose the Mightiest Shield on the Surface for the battle? You're not afraid of Raptures, are you?
It may have been built by a bunch of impostors, but the base is actually looking good. About as good as our outhouse, that is.

Kneel before me and lick my boots,
and perhaps I'll consider seeing you as my commander... for a day.
Heehee, you are falling further behind!
Are you trying to bribe me with this?
Ahem... I can see that you put some thought into this.
I normally don't allow impostors to follow me, but I'll make an exception for you. Just keep it a secret, all right?
I'll put this offering of yours to good use, hehe!

Why are you so eager to have a closer relationship with me?
Well, either way, I won't say no to it.
Time to crush those weaklings. Hehehe.
Like shooting fish in a barrel.
You can't even leave a scratch on my shield.
If only a REAL commander could see this.
